question: X and Y are working as managers in a restaurant but they receive unequal pay for the same work. Which Article of the Directive Principles of State Policy provides for equal pay for equal work?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 39.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 39** of the **Directive Principles of State Policy** provides for **equal pay for equal work.**
 
• **Article 39 **states that the State shall direct its policy towards **securing**, among other things, that there is **equal pay for equal work** for both men and women.
 
• This provision is aimed at **eliminating discrimination** in wages on the basis of** gender**, and ensuring that workers are paid fairly for the work they do.
 
• The Constitution of India recognizes the importance of ensuring **social and economic justice** for all, and the provision for equal pay for equal work is in line with this objective.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 38 **deals with the State's duty to promote the welfare of the people by securing a social order in which** justice, social, economic and political,** shall inform all the institutions of national life.
 
• **Article 41** deals with the **right to work, education, and public assistance** in certain cases. 
 
• **Article 40** deals with the State's duty to organize **village panchayats** and endow them with such powers and authority as may be necessary to enable them to function as units of self-government.
